mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, handover_time, area, note, buyer_confirmed_at, seller_confirmed_at, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM handover_record WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT id, order_id, handover_time, area, note, buyer_confirmed_at, seller_confirmed_at, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM handover_record WHERE order_id IN #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO handover_record (order_id, handover_time, area, note, updated_by) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{handoverTime}, #{area}, #{note}, #{updatedBy})
INSERT INTO handover_log (order_id, changed_by, summary) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{changedBy}, #{summary})
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.changed_by, u.nickname AS changed_by_name, l.summary, l.created_at FROM handover_log l JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.changed_by WHERE l.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY l.id DESC
